title: Small-Balance Cash-Out States and Purchase Refund Windows — Cartwise Gift Cards
content:
Nine states require that a small remaining gift card balance be available in cash: California (CA), Colorado (CO), Maine (ME), Montana (MT), New Jersey (NJ), Oregon (OR), Rhode Island (RI), Vermont (VT) and Washington (WA). For every Cartwise Gift Cards card type, the small-balance figure is 10.00 US dollars, bonus value is not included in a cash-out, and a cash-out closes the card. Separately, each card type has its own purchase refund window for unredeemed cards.

## Table 1 — Small-balance cash-out

| Card type | Cash-out balance threshold (at or below) | States whose law requires the cash-out | Bonus value included | Cash-out closes the card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 10.00 | CA, CO, ME, MT, NJ, OR, RI, VT, WA | No | Yes |

The threshold is a balance at or below which a cash-out is available where state law requires it: a balance of exactly 10.00 is within it, and a balance of 10.01 is not.

## Table 2 — Purchase refund to the purchaser

| Card type | Purchase refund window (calendar days after purchase) | Card must never have been redeemed |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | 30 | Yes |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | 0 | Yes |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | 30 | Yes |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | 0 | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | 14 | Yes |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | 14 | Yes |

The window is the number of calendar days after purchase during which an unredeemed card can be refunded to the purchaser. "Card must never have been redeemed" is Yes on every card type: a purchase refund requires that the card has never been redeemed.

## Legal-side notes

- The state list and the threshold are the same for all six card types; the card type makes no difference to whether a small-balance cash-out is available.
- A cash-out pays out value other than bonus value; bonus value is never part of a cash-out.
- Once cashed out, a card is closed.
